item.title: 1.40.3b1
item.description:
⚠️ BETA RELEASE WARNING

This is an unstable pre-release version intended for testing purposes only.

✨ New Features

  • Adjustable corner roundness for previews
    • Use the new Corner Radius slider in Settings > Appearance > General Appearance, from 0 to 40 pt (default 20)
    • The slider appears when "uniform card radius" is turned on
    • Search for it in settings with "rounded", "corners", "radius", or "roundness"
    • Applies to preview cards, compact rows, windowless-app cards, the outer container, and the search bar
    • Also applies to the calendar and media widgets, pinned widgets, and the drag-over highlight
    • Preview images can now go fully square, with no minimum rounding
    • The Settings preview and any open previews update as you move the slider
    • The search bar's roundness and background update live when you change corner radius, padding, or uniform card radius
  • Two-color running app dots option
    • Turn off "Highlight the frontmost app" in Settings > General > Active App Indicator, with the style set to "Running app dots"
    • Off gives bright dots for apps with open windows and black dots for apps with none
    • On (default) keeps three states: bright for the frontmost app, dimmed for apps with windows, and black for apps with none

🔧 Improvements & Stability

  • Running app dots follow the Dock live
    • Dots keep up with magnification, adding or removing icons, Dock resizing or moving, and switching Spaces
    • Dots fade in smoothly
    • Color changes no longer make the row jump
  • Less stutter when launching apps
    • Opening an app no longer briefly freezes DockDoor
    • Dots update more smoothly as windows open and close

🐛 Bug Fixes

  • Running app dots appear when the Dock is summoned over a full-screen app
    • Dots show when you reveal an auto-hidden Dock and disappear when it hides again
    • Find the option in Settings > General > Active App Indicator, style "Running app dots"
  • Liquid Glass backgrounds on short elements render as clean pills
    • Fixes distortion on the search bar and compact rows when the corner radius is large
  • Search bar hint shows your current search shortcut
    • The "Press <key> to search windows…" text no longer shows an old key after you change it in Settings
  • Siri no longer opens DockDoor Settings
    • Clicking the app icon or relaunching DockDoor still opens Settings
